SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) AS total_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id) AS paid_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = u.id)) AS never_paid_users

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN o_cnt = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_order_users,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o_cnt > 0 AND paid_cnt = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_but_never_paid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN paid_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_users
FROM (
  SELECT u.id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS o_cnt,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS paid_cnt
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
  LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
  GROUP BY u.id
) t
